AffectedDependency.title: AffectedDependency
AffectedDependency.description:
A commit or image whose SBOM reaches one of an advisory's packages. `vulnerable`: the
advisory names the package itself, else it leads to one (an internal library, a base image).
No `repository_ref_id`: an image with no declared provenance.

Assessment.title: Assessment
Assessment.description: 3a · what was examined: a ref (and image), by an assessor, with what outcome.

Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
Checkpoint.description: A layer after restamping its root; `warning` is what the caller must surface.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: A judgement on a finding; corrections are new decisions (restates_id).

DecisionBody.title: DecisionBody
DecisionBody.description: A countersign or re-rating; the finding is the path, never the body (no id confusion).

Disposition.title: Disposition
Disposition.description: A finding's merged judgement, ordered only by explicit E0-E3 evidence strength.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: 5 · the proof of one decision: its leaf in a layer.

FeedEvent.title: FeedEvent
FeedEvent.description:
One change on the ops feed: an order reaching a `FEED_ORDER_STATES` state (with its
reason), a new assessment, or a recorded release. Exactly one is set.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description: 3b · one weakness or vulnerability in a repository, identified by fingerprint.

Layer.title: Layer
Layer.description: 5 · one Merkle tree of decision events for a repository (or one line), signed per root.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: The location table: where an occurrence was reported, relative to its commit.

ModelUsage.title: ModelUsage
ModelUsage.description:
One model request's token usage, and the skill running then, as a transcript reader
parsed them.

Occurrence.title: Occurrence
Occurrence.description: A finding as one assessment reported it.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: The error body every route returns (RFC 9457 problem details).

RefDependency.title: RefDependency
RefDependency.description: A package at one version in an SBOM: a commit's manifest or an image's.

RepositoryRef.title: RepositoryRef
RepositoryRef.description: A commit, optionally on a named branch or tag; a line is (repository_id, name).

RestatementBody.title: RestatementBody
RestatementBody.description: An administrator's correction; the decision is the path, never the body.

ReviewCase.title: ReviewCase
ReviewCase.description: One thing for a person: a fold state on a finding, or a pending review item.

ReviewCaseKind.title: ReviewCaseKind
ReviewCaseKind.description: Why a person must look, worst first: the fold's states, then a pending review item.

RunOrder.title: RunOrder
RunOrder.description: 4a · one unit of work; queued, leased by a worker, finished with an outcome.

Signing.title: Signing
Signing.description: How signing a layer's root went (traust-ledger `SignAttempt.status`).
